briefdescription.para: Compose the priority of an active object.

parameterdescription.para: Base priority of the active object.
Preemption-threshold of the active object.

detaileddescription.para:
The priority is composed of two parts packed into a 16-bit value:
The lower 8 bits represent the base priority.
The upper 8 bits represent the preemption-threshold.
Use the macro EDF_AO_PRIO(prio, pthre) to compose this value.

simplesect.para: Priority numbering is ascending (1 = lowest), up to EDF_MAX_ACTIVE_OBJECT.

xrefdescription.para: Consider separating base priority and preemption-threshold into distinct typedefs and removing the EDF_activeObject_prio_t type from all usage sites, to improve clarity and avoid packing both values into a single type.

detaileddescription.para:
Preemption threshold
Each AO has a priority (prio) and an optional preemption-threshold (pthre).
prio decides scheduling order.
pthre limits which higher-priority AOs can preempt this AO.
if not specified, pthre = prio (default).
AOs with prio ≤ pthre cannot preempt it (same group).
Only AOs with prio > pthre can preempt.
This allows grouping AOs to avoid unnecessary preemptions while still preserving responsiveness to truly higher priorities.
For consistency, each AO’s pthre must not be smaller than its lower prio neighbor and must not be greater than its higher prio neighbor.

briefdescription.para: Publishes an event to all subscribed active objects.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the event to be published.

simplesect.para: If a lower-priority AO publishes to a higher-priority one, it can preempt and recycle the event before multicasting finishes, prematurely freeing it from the pool. To prevent this, the reference counter of a mutable event is incremented before multicasting. At the end, EDF_event_gc() decrements the counter and recycles the event if it drops to zero.
